title: Lob Entry Pass
description: When a post player is fronted, the passer lobs the ball over the defender for a catch near the rim; timing and touch are everything.

content.objective: Read a fronted post and deliver a lob that only the post player can catch, with the right height and landing spot.
content.setup: Passer at the wing; post player at the block with a defender fronting them.
instructions: The post player seals the fronting defender with their back and a raised target hand toward the rim.
The passer reads the front and the weak side: no help means lob.
Throw a two-hand overhead lob aimed above the front of the rim.
The post player releases the seal, catches high and finishes.
If weak-side help is there, swing the ball instead.
coachingPoints: Aim for the space between the post and the rim, not at the post's hands.
Soft lob with arc, not a line drive.
Post holds the seal until the ball passes over the defender.
commonMistakes: Lob too flat for the defender to deflect.
Lob too long, out of bounds.
Post releasing early and pushing off.
content.safety: Defender fronts but does not undercut the jumping post player.
progressions: Add a weak-side helper who can rotate.
Pass from the top instead of the wing.
variations: High-low lob from the elbow to the block.
successCriteria: 6 of 10 lobs caught at the rim.
No lob thrown into weak-side help.
content.gameApplication: Fronted posts are open behind the defense; the lob punishes the front.
